input.prompt: A classic New York City cast-iron sidewalk fire hydrant: a stout cylindrical barrel painted glossy red with a round flanged base ring, a domed bonnet on top with a pentagonal operating nut, two side hose outlets with chained caps and one larger front outlet cap, the bonnet and all caps painted silver. Slightly worn paint. Product photo for 3D reconstruction: exactly one object, shown whole and centred with a generous empty margin on every side, nothing cropped. Three-quarter front view from slightly above (camera about 20 degrees above the horizon and about 35 degrees off the front axis), a long lens with little perspective distortion. Isolated on a plain, seamless, uniform pure white background. Soft, even, diffuse studio lighting from all around: no harsh highlights, no cast shadow or contact shadow, no floor, no reflections of surroundings. No other objects, no people, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no badges, no watermark. Photorealistic, sharp, accurate real-world proportions and materials.
